name: Padmanabh Alloys and Polymers Limited
summary: Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers Ltd. is a manufacturer focused on plastic products. The company's extensive portfolio features general compounds, engineering plastics, and masterbatches. Specifically, their range includes mineral-filled thermoplastics, mineral masterbatches, synthetic paper masterbatches, glass-reinforced thermoplastics, and various other specialized masterbatch formulations. Founded on November 9, 1994, the firm's primary operations are based out of Surat, India.
